title: 第901章 三成第900章 讨价还价
content_zh:
权衡利弊之后，荒兽天帝只得压下怒火，冷冷道：“那你且说说看，你还想要什么条件？”
苏辰淡笑道：“除了要送我和我的女人，安然离开黑雾深渊之外，转化而成的帝玄晶，也必须分给我一部分才行。”
荒兽天帝微微眯起眼睛，冷声道：“你想分多少？”
苏辰竖起五根手指，毫不犹豫道：“五五分，我要分走一半。”
“不可能！”
荒兽天帝瞬间勃然大怒，凌厉的杀气抑制不住爆发而出：“小子，你找死！
你别忘了，这里是本帝的地盘，你屠杀本帝那么多手下的账，本帝还没有和你清算，不要太得寸进尺了！”
面对荒兽天帝的愤怒，苏辰没有丝毫恐惧，也没有退却或服软之意，若无其事笑道：“无妨，那等什么时候可能了，咱们再继续谈。”
“什么？小子，你别想逃！”
荒兽天帝脸色一变，挥手凝聚出一道浓烈的黑光，以快到出现残影的速度轰向苏辰。
尽管荒兽天帝已经第一时间出手，却还是晚了一步。
黑光接触到苏辰衣角的瞬间，苏辰身形一闪，再次凭空消失，连气息都瞬间无影无踪，仿佛从来没有出现过在这里一般。
“小子，你给我出来！”
荒兽天帝怒不可遏，厉声喝道：“你就算净化出再多的帝玄晶，也是源自本帝的荒芜之气，其他的条件本帝都可以和你谈，想要分帝玄晶走，没门！”
天机宝玉空间内，看着怒气冲冲的荒兽天帝，苏辰没有再给他任何回应。
漫天要价，坐地还钱，这个价码当然是可以谈的，但必须要等对方先主动退步，他才能得到真正想要的回报。
看着荒兽天帝暴怒如雷的样子，洛雪儿有些担忧：“少爷，帝玄晶虽然珍贵，但绝情谷那边的情况更加危急，如果和这家伙彻底谈崩，我们短时间便几乎不可能有机会离开这里了……”
“雪儿，你只管放心吧，我心中有数。”
苏辰自信笑道：“这种与虎谋皮的谈判，我再擅长不过，在黑雾深渊这片地界内，他作为荒兽天帝确实占据着绝对的主导权，但我的手中握有他无法拒绝的筹码，只要拉扯下去，他便一定会让步。”
洛雪儿心中仍有些担忧，但也只是点了点头，没有再多说什么。

面对荒兽天帝这种级别的强者，如果是她孤身一人，肯定会不顾一切拼命逃跑，根本不可能有与其谈判的勇气。
少爷既然不仅敢与之谈判，更是如此大胆地讨价还价，就一定有他的把握。
……
眨眼间，整整三天的时间过去。
这三天内，苏辰也没有浪费时间，在天机宝玉空间内，同雪儿一起安心修炼。
而荒兽天帝则始终在外界寸步不离，两眼死死盯着苏辰消失的位置，想要洞悉他凭空消失的玄机。
然而，整整三天下来，荒兽天帝寸步未离，目不转睛，还悄然发动了三四次秘术进行探查，却根本无法捕捉到苏辰和洛雪儿一丝一毫的气息。
这让荒兽天帝更加确信，苏辰手中这件空间秘宝的强大，要远远凌驾于他的实力之上，如果自己不妥协退步的话，这两个人类武者是真的可以和他耗到天荒地老。
想到将荒芜之气转化成帝玄晶，能给自己带来多么巨大的方便和利益，荒兽天帝犹豫再三，终究是咬了咬牙：“好，小子，你既然也迫切需要帝玄晶，那本帝可以分你一些，但是，最多只能分你一成！”
“一成？阁下是拿我当叫花子打发吗？”
苏辰没有现身，只是传来略带戏谑的声音，冷笑道：“我不是不允许你划价，但你既然一刀直接砍到底，一丁点诚意都没有，那我们也没有什么谈的必要。”
“小子，你不要贪得无厌，一成的帝玄晶，对于你这种低阶武圣级别的蝼蚁，已经是你这辈子都无法企及的财富了！”
荒兽天帝厉声怒斥，但苏辰的声音却再次消失，根本不再给他一丝回应，气得荒兽天帝咬牙切齿，却又无可奈何。
又是三天时间过去，苏辰和洛雪儿依然稳坐钓鱼台，根本没有半点妥协之意。
荒兽天帝有些耐不住性子，只得再次让步，冷冷道：“两成，这是本帝能接受的极限，小子，你最好考虑清楚，若是将我的耐心耗尽，你便再寻不到这等无本万利的买卖了！”
“无本万利？阁下的话说得可真轻巧，难道我这门秘术是天生就会吗？”
苏辰冷笑道：“如果这笔买卖真的那么简单，阁下去找谁来合作都可以，又何必和我浪费这么久的时间？两成这个价格还是太低，等你将真正的诚心拿出来，咱们再谈吧。”
荒兽天帝勃然大怒，整个帝殿都席卷起冷厉的阴风：“小子，本帝已经一退再退，你不要欺人太甚！
整个太渊晦墟，除了你之外，还有哪个人类和荒兽敢和本帝讨价还价？！”
他的怒火和杀意直接冲出神殿，席卷整个沧溟天，甚至让沧溟天外的狱牛荒兽都感受得清清楚楚，躲在黑雾中瑟瑟发抖不停。

然而，眼看着自己的威压已经释放到极致，苏辰的回应却再次消失，不再给予他任何回应，荒兽天帝的怒气也一下子就泄了。
反正不论他做什么，这两个人类武者也不会受到半点影响，自己再是暴怒，又有什么意义？
又经过三天的纠结和挣扎，荒兽天帝内心的焦躁越来越膨胀，终于彻底沉不住气，摊开了自己真正的底线。
“转化之后的帝玄晶，本帝最多那可以分给你三成，超过这个数字，这个合作对本帝来说是不赚反赔，如果这个价格你依旧不满意，那就自便吧。”
content_en:
After weighing the pros and cons, the Desolate Beast Emperor could only suppress his anger and said coldly: "Then tell me, what other conditions do you want?"
Su Chen smiled lightly and said: "In addition to sending me and my woman out of the Black Mist Abyss safely, I must also share a part of the transformed Emperor Xuan Crystal."
The Desolate Beast Emperor narrowed his eyes slightly and said coldly: "How much do you want to share?"
Su Chen raised five fingers and said without hesitation: "Fifty-fifty, I want to take half."
"Impossible!"
The Desolate Beast Emperor was instantly furious, and his fierce murderous aura could not be suppressed and burst out: "Boy, you are looking for death!
Don’t forget, this is my territory, and I haven’t settled the account with you for massacring so many of my men, so don’t be too pushy! "
Facing the wrath of the Desolate Beast Emperor, Su Chen didn't have the slightest fear, nor did he intend to retreat or give in. He smiled as if nothing had happened and said, "It doesn't matter, let's continue talking when it's possible."
"What? Boy, don't even think about escaping!"
The Desolate Beast Emperor's expression changed, and he waved his hand to condense a strong black light, which hit Su Chen at a speed so fast that afterimages appeared.
Although the Desolate Beast Emperor had taken action immediately, it was still a step too late.
The moment the black light touched the corner of Su Chen's clothes, Su Chen's figure flashed and disappeared out of thin air again. Even his breath disappeared instantly, as if he had never appeared here before.
"Boy, come out here!"
The Desolate Beast Heavenly Emperor was furious and shouted sternly: "No matter how many Emperor Xuan Crystals you purify, they still come from my desolate energy. I can negotiate with you for other conditions. If you want the Emperor Xuan Crystal to leave, there is no way!"
In the space of Tianji Baoyu, Su Chen looked at the angry Emperor of Desolate Beast, but Su Chen didn't give him any response.
Asking for a price and paying back the money, of course the price can be negotiated, but he must wait for the other party to take the initiative to back down before he can get the return he really wants.
Seeing the furious rage of the Desolate Beast Emperor, Luo Xueer was a little worried: "Young master, although the Emperor Xuan Crystal is precious, the situation in the Jueqing Valley is even more critical. If we completely break up with this guy, it will be almost impossible for us to leave here in a short time..."
"Xue'er, just don't worry, I know what's going on."
Su Chen smiled confidently and said: "I am very good at this kind of negotiation with a tiger seeking skin. In the Black Mist Abyss, he does have absolute dominance as the Emperor of Wild Beasts, but I have a bargaining chip in my hand that he cannot refuse. As long as I pull it, he will definitely give in."
Luo Xueer was still a little worried, but she just nodded and said nothing more.
Facing a powerful man of the level of the Desolate Beast Emperor, if she were alone, she would definitely run away at all costs, and it would be impossible for her to have the courage to negotiate with him.
Since the young master not only dares to negotiate with him, but also bargains so boldly, he must be sure of it.
…
In the blink of an eye, three full days passed.
In the past three days, Su Chen did not waste time and practiced peacefully with Xueer in the Tianji Baoyu space.
The Desolate Beast Heavenly Emperor has always stayed close to the outside world, staring at the location where Su Chen disappeared, trying to understand the mystery of his disappearance out of thin air.
However, for three whole days, the Desolate Beast Heavenly Emperor remained unmoved, staring intently, and quietly launched three or four secret techniques to detect, but was unable to capture the slightest breath of Su Chen and Luo Xueer.
This made the Desolate Beast Emperor even more convinced that the power of the secret space treasure in Su Chen's hand was far greater than his strength. If he did not compromise and retreat, these two human warriors could really fight him forever.
Thinking of the great convenience and benefits that transforming the desolate energy into the Emperor Xuan Crystal would bring to him, the Desolate Beast Emperor hesitated again and again, and finally gritted his teeth: "Okay, boy, since you also urgently need the Emperor Xuan Crystal, then I can share some with you, but in the end, in the end,I can only give you 10% at most! "
"One percent? Are you treating me like a beggar? "
Su Chen did not show up, but there was a slightly joking voice, and he sneered: "I don't allow you to negotiate the price, but since you cut it to the end with one knife and have no sincerity at all, then there is no need for us to talk. "
"Boy, don't be greedy. 10% of the Emperor Xuan Crystal is already a wealth that you, a low-level Martial Saint-level ant like you, can never reach in your life! "
The Desolate Beast Emperor sternly reprimanded, but Su Chen's voice disappeared again, and there was no response from him at all. The Desolate Beast Emperor was so angry that he gritted his teeth, but he was helpless.
Another three days have passed, and Su Chen and Luo Xueer are still sitting firmly on the Diaoyutai, with no intention of compromise at all.
The Desolate Beast Emperor couldn't bear his temper, so he had to give in again and said coldly: "Twenty percent, this is the limit that this emperor can accept. Boy, you'd better think about it carefully. If my patience is exhausted, you will never find such a worthless deal again! "
"Nothing but profit? Your words are so easy to say. Am I born with this secret skill? "
Su Chen sneered: "If this deal is really that simple, you can find anyone to cooperate with you, so why waste so much time with me? The price of 20% is still too low. Let’s talk about it again when you show your true sincerity. "
The Desolate Beast Emperor was furious, and a cold and harsh wind swept through the entire palace: "Boy, this emperor has retreated again and again, don't bully others too much!
In the entire Taiyuan Huixu, apart from you, which human being or wild beast dares to bargain with this emperor? ! "
His anger and murderous intent rushed out of the temple and swept through the entire Cangmingtian. Even the prison bull beasts outside the Cangmingtian felt it clearly, hiding in the black mist and shivering.
However, seeing that his pressure had been released to the extreme, Su Chen's response disappeared again, no longer giving him any response, and the anger of the Desolate Beast Emperor was suddenly vented.
Anyway, no matter what he does, these two human warriors will not be affected in the slightest. What's the point of being furious again?
After another three days of entanglement and struggle, the inner anxiety of the Desolate Beast Emperor became more and more swollen, and he finally lost all composure and revealed his true bottom line.
"After the transformation of the Emperor Xuan Crystal, I can give you 30% at most. If it exceeds this number, this cooperation will be a loss for me. If you are still not satisfied with the price, then do whatever you want. "
